notes.title: June Update!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/fe207aa223a38af3c840f545cf6dfea64bfb04fd.png"][/img]

Hello friends, here’s a quick June update![/p][p][/p][h3]Southeast Asian Games Showcase[/h3][p]This month, we joined the Southeast Asian Games Showcase (SEAGS) at Summer Game Fest 2025! 

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Oe4Pm3nYGv8"][/dynamiclink]
Drop by the event to check out other awesome games from Southeast Asian developers.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/southeastasiangamesshowcase"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/southeastasiangamesshowcase[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/f257a5feaa08efe80436b90ebc340be29f44f419.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Character Voting[/h3][p]We’re holding a voting for Doma’s character, and it closes in 3 days! Haven’t voted yet? [url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/which-doma-do-129996766"]Head over to our Patreon to pick your favorite[/url].. just log in, no paid subscription needed! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/30a07e32ed46adadcb747742d0bd703a5579038b.png"][/img][url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/which-doma-do-129996766"]https://www.patreon.com/posts/which-doma-do-129996766[/url]
[/p][h3]Steam Next Fest[/h3][p]At Steam Next Fest June 2025, Noobzilla showcased Cats Around Us: Black Cat and hit over 1,000 wishlists! Huge thanks for all your amazing support![/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Next month, we’re planning to reopen Community Translation for Cats Around Us. If you’re excited to translate our cat descriptions into your language, follow our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/noobzilla/"]Developer Page[/url] so you don’t miss the sign-up details![/p][p]
That’s all for now.

Warm regards, and here’s to a joyful day![/p][p][/p][p]UB & Estu 

PS : dont forget to wishlist our upcoming games [/p][p]

notes.title: May Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/2b9aabf3e3c8c4afbf03ed957467313be90b2f3c.png[/img]

Hi friends!

Can you believe we’re already in the third week of May? How’s everyone doing?
We hope you’re all doing great! :D And if things are a bit rough right now, we really hope everything gets better soon and that happiness finds its way back to you 💖

We’ve got a few updates we’d love to share with you! :D

First up, the demo for Cats Around Us is now available! ^^
It’s a short demo (because the game is short too XD), so feel free to give it a try! And if you haven’t wishlisted it yet, now’s the perfect time to hit that wishlist button :D

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426090/Cats_Around_Us_Black_Cat/

---

Second, it's been 25 days since Cats and Seek: Tokyo launched!
It’s already been played by over 8,000 players and has gotten 100+ reviews with a Very Positive rating! Thank you so, so much for all the love and support 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2925320/Cats_and_Seek_Tokyo/

---

And last but not least, we gave our Noobzilla logo a little makeover!
We think it looks much cuter and more adorable now ^^ Hope you like it too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/f2d6b2139dfd84a99bb6cbe276ad1abd5f496352.png[/img]



That’s all for now!
Thanks a bunch for taking the time to read this little update :D
Warm hugs and have a lovely day!



– UB & Estu

P.S. Don’t forget to wishlist Pictective too, pretty please ^^ Thank you! 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690390/Pictective/
